settings.title: WhatsApp
settings.description: Connect your own Meta WhatsApp Business account and manage templates and automatic notifications.
settings.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

connection.title: WhatsApp Business account
connection.intro: Messages are sent from your own Meta account and number; Meta bills you directly.

steps.title: Before you connect
steps.app: Create an app in Meta for Developers and add the WhatsApp product.
steps.systemUser: Create a system user in Business Manager and generate a permanent token with the whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions.
steps.ids: Copy the WhatsApp Business Account ID and Phone Number ID from WhatsApp Manager.
steps.webhook: Enter the webhook URL and verify token below in your app and subscribe to the "messages" field.

connection.accessTokenHelp: System user token. It is never shown again after saving.
connection.accessTokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved token (••••{{last4}}).
connection.appSecretHelp: Used to verify the webhook signature (X-Hub-Signature-256).
connection.idInvalid: Enter a numeric ID of 6–20 digits.
connection.tokenInvalid: The token must be at least 20 characters.
connection.secretInvalid: The app secret is a 32-character hexadecimal value.
connection.disconnectDescription: Sending and automatic notifications stop and templates are removed. Conversation history is kept.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Incoming messages and delivery statuses are sent to this URL.

templates.managedDescription: These utility templates are prepared for your {{modules}} industry, submitted to your WhatsApp Business account automatically and used once Meta approves them. Templates cannot be edited.
templates.notConnected: Templates are submitted for Meta's review as soon as WhatsApp is connected.

rejections.INVALID_FORMAT: The format does not follow Meta's rules.
rejections.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The content does not match the selected category (utility).
rejections.PROMOTIONAL: Promotional content is not allowed in utility templates.

templates.empty: Your active modules have no WhatsApp templates.

notifications.title: Automatic notifications
notifications.description: When the event happens, the approved template is sent to the related person automatically — only to people who opted in.
notifications.notConnected: Connect WhatsApp first to use automatic notifications.
